tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Web hosting and VPS plans with monthly and yearly prices in BDT, what each includes, who it suits, and order links.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Checks whether a domain name can be registered at Hostamir, with first-year and renewal prices in BDT and an order link. Give a full name (yourshop.com) or a name plus up to 5 extensions.

tools.name: domain_prices
tools.description: Current yearly prices in BDT (register, renew, transfer) for up to 40 domain extensions. Many are cheaper in the first year.

tools.name: order_link
tools.description: A link the customer opens to order a plan (monthly or yearly), register a domain or transfer one. The customer completes the order and pays on clients.hostamir.com.

tools.name: support_info
tools.description: How to contact Hostamir, opening hours, payment methods, refunds, backups, what happens after ordering, and where existing customers manage services.
